_about: The public build log. Newest first. One plain line per thing that reached people (live, on testers' phones or on the web), written for a stranger. Lines come from Claude: by hand in a site session, or by the nightly build log job, which checks each line with tools/board_guard.py and a private word list before it adds it with tools/board.py. Never name a person, a client or anything private. A line stays only if a stranger can picture what changed: no build number without what a person can now do.

entries.line: The voice checker stopped marking a person's own plain writing as AI.
Bird League players can add a photo to any bird they've already logged.
The website checkup is live: paste your site's address and get a plain report of what's broken, worst first.
A new free tool: paste words written with AI and see which sentences give it away.
dragomansjourney.com got its new chart-paper look.
New Bird League players get a short welcome and land in a league near them.
Birdsighted got a 20-picture Eye Test and its own icon.
The cooking app finds the recipes you can make with what's in the fridge.
Bird League added safety settings for its teen players.
Bird League runs on Android now, as well as iPhone.
New Bird League players see the birds near them first.
Deepcuts' Gift Room went live: describe a friend and get up to three indie games to send them.
Bird League players can submit their best photos to a shared gallery.
Birdsighted, a detective game for birders, went onto testers' phones.
Four free tools went live, including a recipe scaler and a shot list maker for phone video.
Open Leagues went live in Bird League: anyone can join a league and play.
The cooking app got the program's logo everywhere and an easier font to read.
The program's leaders started testing the cooking app on their own phones.
Deepcuts got its new look.
All 15 songs on the album are written. Production started.
Bird League build 49: the map crash fixed, new stats cards, sharper art.
The first Deepcuts build went up to TestFlight, Apple's testing app.
The program's own recipes went into the cooking app, ready to print.
Bird League's sound ID now runs on its own, and newcomers get a trophy ceremony.
dragomansjourney.com went live.
Duel medals went live in Bird League.
Bird League players can now send their sightings to eBird in one tap.
The Deepcuts iPhone app was built overnight.
Bird League got The Almanac and a trophy ceremony.
The kids' cooking app runs on Android as well as iPhone and iPad.
